title: Arcadion
summary_html: Arcadion is a daemon who is introduced in the expansion pack for Ultima VII, the Forge of Virtue, and who later appears in Ultima VII Part Two and potentially in Ultima VIII. He is bound to the Black Sword, an artifact of great power wielded by the Avatar of Britannia.
